about: The operating system packages an isle needs when it is installed with no internet: the roots of a dependency set, beside what the isle's own packages declare. Written once, with the package names of the newest supported system; supported-os.json says which names an older system uses. install: what the offline installer installs. cacheOnly: carried in the set so it can be installed later, never installed by the installer. An entry 'a | b' means either package serves; the first is the one a set is resolved with. Read by isle os dependencies build and by the suite's builder of an offline medium (supported_os.py offline-packages).
